name: Crazed Films
headquarters: The production house "Crazed Films" was established in the middle of 2023, precisely in August. Founded with the principle of creating something "crazy," Crazed Films was established with careful consideration and the hope of producing works that leave a lasting impact on the audience. Several stories and films are currently in the process, and, of course, this stage is being carried out with maximum effort and thoroughness. True to its name, Crazed Films creates films born from crazy and brilliant ideas.
